name: webhook-delivery-retry-p2
prompt: how do I make sure my outgoing webhooks eventually reach the customer even when their endpoint is briefly down

chunks.content: restyled the confirmation modal to use the new button tokens and a softer drop shadow
scheduled a nightly VACUUM ANALYZE on the events table to keep the planner statistics fresh
the on-call alert fires when our own ingress endpoint returns 5xx for more than two minutes
wrapped the new billing screen behind a toggle so we can dark-launch it to staff first
include an idempotency key header on each delivery attempt so a retried webhook is not processed twice by the customer
for webhooks we receive from Stripe we verify the signature header and reject anything where the customer payload hmac does not match
rotated the login signing key and shortened access token lifetime to 15 minutes
format currency amounts according to the viewer's locale in the dashboard
the admin dashboard now shows the top API consumers by request count over the last hour
added a CSV export button on the analytics page that streams rows to the browser
the signup flow sends a welcome email through the marketing provider after the account is confirmed
decided to queue each outbound webhook in a durable outbox table and have a worker drain it, so a notification is not lost if the receiver is momentarily unreachable
failed deliveries get re-attempted on a schedule of 1m, 5m, 30m, 2h before we give up and mark the event dead-lettered
expose a per-event delivery status (pending, delivered, failed) so support can see whether the customer endpoint ever acknowledged it
